title: tripleurospermum breviradiatum
intro: Tripleurospermum breviradiatum, commonly known as Rough Meadowparsnip or Meadow Parsley, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various ailments such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit analgesic and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Tripleurospermum breviradiatum include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
